Definition: Kelub, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kelub is the name of two Israelites. 1 Chronicles 4:11 says Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton. 1 Chronicles 27:26 says over them that did the work of the field was Ezri the son of Chelub.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe both Kelubs are kept for the same reason: one fathered a family, and the other raised a son who tilled David's fields.
